headline: SBI Mutual Fund | SIF NFO: SBI Mutual Fund's SIF receives strong response, raises record ₹1,154 crore from NFO
summary: SBI Mutual Fund's specialised investment fund (SIF) received a strong response and raised a record ₹1,154 crore from its NFO. It is the largest NFO collection to date by an equity-oriented SIF.
why: Specialised investment funds are a newer category of Indian mutual funds, and inflows into them reflect domestic retail and institutional participation in equity markets.
